## Geographic change

Describe your observations, source dates, scope and license/permission. Attach the editor-exported changeset in `contributions/`.

- [ ] Full source references and licenses are retained; no restricted map copying.
- [ ] Expected dataset/feature hashes match the current canonical version.
- [ ] I reviewed CI's before/after GeoJSON artifact and human-readable summary.
- [ ] Changes to connectivity/access have been reviewed against real roads.
- [ ] Any administrative correction is explicitly identified for elevated review.

Boundary changes require two maintainer approvals. Other geography requires at least one. Repository protection must enforce this policy before production publication; CI reporting alone is not enforcement.
